title: Art club: an offer to study abroad

cues.text: In the school lobby, you and Fuuka wait outside the faculty office while the advisor talks with Keisuke inside.
A girl comes running up behind you and Fuuka, and Fuuka holds a hand to her chest. The faculty office door opens, and Keisuke comes out with the advisor, a woman with short hair.
Keisuke runs off with the student.
The advisor walks away down the hall, leaving you and Fuuka by the office door.
